player_0.content: New plan: I incorrectly classified the truncation of the full name "Georg Otto Bussenius" to "Otto" as a Named Entity error, when the specific error type defined in the prompt for removing a significant part of the sentence (the first and last name) is "Dropped Content". My strategy should be to strictly map the physical absence of text segments to "Dropped Content" unless the remaining text constitutes a completely different entity. Next time, I will identify that "Georg" and "Bussenius" are missing from the translation and classify this omission as (E) Dropped Content.
